# Asteroid Escape

- Top‑down canvas game where the player pilots a small ship.
- Use arrow keys to thrust and dodge continuously spawning asteroids.
- Collect fuel canisters to stay alive.
- Lose if the ship crashes into an asteroid or runs out of fuel.
- Score is based on survival time and collected fuel.

1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas must have id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
8: 
9:   // Ship
10:   const ship = {x: W/2, y: H/2, r: 10, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: 0.2, fuel: 100};
11:   const keys = {};
12: 
13:   // Entities
14:   const asteroids = [];
15:   const fuels = [];
16:   let score = 0;
17:   let lastTime = 0;
18:   let gameOver = false;
19: 
20:   // Helpers
21:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
22:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
23:   // Sound effects
24:   const thrustSound = new Audio('https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/cartoon/slide_1.wav');
25:   const explosionSound = new Audio('https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/explosions/explosion_01.wav');
26:   const fuelSound = new Audio('https://actions.google.com/sounds/v1/foley/metal_clank_001.wav');
27:   let thrustPlaying = false;
28:   // Starfield init
29:   const starCount = 100;
30:   const stars = [];
31:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
32:     stars.push({
33:       x: rand(0, W),
34:       y: rand(0, H),
35:       alpha: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
36:     });
37:   }
38: 
39:   // Input
40:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
41:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
42: 
43:   function spawnAsteroid() {
44:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4));
45:     const obj = {r: rand(8, 20)};
46:     switch (side) {
47:       case 0: obj.x = 0; obj.y = rand(0, H); break; // left
48:       case 1: obj.x = W; obj.y = rand(0, H); break; // right
49:       case 2: obj.x = rand(0, W); obj.y = 0; break; // top
50:       case 3: obj.x = rand(0, W); obj.y = H; break; // bottom
51:     }
52:     const angle = Math.atan2(ship.y - obj.y, ship.x - obj.x);
53:     const speed = rand(0.5, 1.5);
54:     obj.vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
55:     obj.vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
56:     asteroids.push(obj);
57:   }
58: 
59:   function spawnFuel() {
60:     const obj = {
61:       x: rand(20, W-20),
62:       y: rand(20, H-20),
63:       r: 6,
64:     };
65:     fuels.push(obj);
66:   }
67: 
68:   function update(dt) {
69:     if (gameOver) return;
70:     // Ship controls
71:     const thrusting = keys['ArrowUp']||keys['ArrowDown']||keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['ArrowRight'];
72:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) { ship.vy -= ship.speed; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
73:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) { ship.vy += ship.speed; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
74:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) { ship.vx -= ship.speed; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
75:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) { ship.vx += ship.speed; ship.fuel -= 0.02; }
76:     // Thrust sound management
77:     if (thrusting) {
78:       if (!thrustPlaying) { thrustSound.loop = true; thrustSound.play(); thrustPlaying = true; }
79:     } else {
80:       if (thrustPlaying) { thrustSound.pause(); thrustSound.currentTime = 0; thrustPlaying = false; }
81:     }
82:     // Apply friction
83:     ship.vx *= 0.99; ship.vy *= 0.99;
84:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt; ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
85:     // Keep inside bounds
86:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = 0; if (ship.x > W) ship.x = W;
87:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = 0; if (ship.y > H) ship.y = H;
88:     // Update asteroids
89:     for (let i = asteroids.length-1; i >=0; i--) {
90:       const a = asteroids[i];
91:       a.x += a.vx * dt; a.y += a.vy * dt;
92:       // collision with ship
93:       if (dist(a, ship) < a.r + ship.r) {
94:         if (!gameOver) explosionSound.play();
95:         gameOver = true;
96:       }
97:       // remove off‑screen
98:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > W+50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > H+50) asteroids.splice(i,1);
99:     }
100:     // Fuel pickups
101:     for (let i = fuels.length-1; i >=0; i--) {
102:       const f = fuels[i];
103:       if (dist(f, ship) < f.r + ship.r) {
104:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
105:         fuelSound.play();
106:         fuels.splice(i,1);
107:       }
108:     }
109:     // Spawn logic
110:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
111:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnFuel();
112:     // Score & end conditions
113:     score += dt/1000;
114:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
115:   }
116: 
117:   function draw() {
118:     // Background starfield
119:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
120:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
121:     for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
122:       const s = stars[i];
123:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + s.alpha + ')';
124:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
125:     }
126: 
127:     // Ship (triangle oriented to movement)
128:     ctx.save();
129:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
130:     const angle = Math.atan2(ship.vy, ship.vx) || 0;
131:     ctx.rotate(angle);
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
133:     ctx.beginPath();
134:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
135:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
136:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
137:     ctx.closePath();
138:     ctx.fill();
139:     ctx.restore();
140: 
141:     // Asteroids (simple polygon shapes)
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a33';
143:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
144:       ctx.save();
145:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
146:       ctx.rotate(a.angle || 0);
147:       ctx.beginPath();
148:       const sides = 6 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
149:       const step = (Math.PI * 2) / sides;
150:       for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
151:         const rad = a.r * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);
152:         ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(i * step) * rad, Math.sin(i * step) * rad);
153:       }
154:       ctx.closePath();
155:       ctx.fill();
156:       ctx.restore();
157:     });
158: 
159:     // Fuel pickups (glowing radial gradient)
160:     fuels.forEach(f => {
161:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x, f.y, 0, f.x, f.y, f.r);
162:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.8)');
163:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.2)');
164:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
165:       ctx.beginPath();
166:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
167:       ctx.fill();
168:     });
169: 
170:     // HUD
171:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
172:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
173:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
174:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
175:     if (gameOver) {
176:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
177:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
178:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
179:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
180:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
181:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
182:     }
183:   }
184: 
185:   function loop(timestamp) {
186:     const dt = timestamp - (lastTime || timestamp);
187:     lastTime = timestamp;
188:     update(dt);
189:     draw();
190:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
191:   }
192:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
193: })();

(End of file - total 193 lines)
</content>
